PyTorch’s GRU equations show that zero-valued padding can still change hidden states through biases and recurrence. Extra left padding therefore need not preserve outputs for a GRU that processes padding normally. `pack_padded_sequence` retains the first `length` timesteps: directly packing left-padded histories can retain padding and discard real interactions. For this task, audit the final nonpadding readout; `count-1` indexes incorrectly in left-padded tensors. An unpadded reference is equivalent only when the trained implementation skips padding transitions. [GRU documentation](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/main/generated/torch.nn.GRU.html), [packing documentation](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/main/generated/torch.nn.utils.rnn.pack_padded_sequence.html).

PyTorch explicitly warns that batched versus individual computations can differ numerically. Suggested checks: establish repeated-execution variation with the same checkpoint in evaluation mode, then compare singleton, duplicated, permuted and differently partitioned batches, restoring row order before comparison. Record absolute/relative feature and score errors, top-10 overlap, and score margins around rank 10. Repetition measures nondeterminism; batch transformations probe execution sensitivity. Use float64 or stricter precision settings as diagnostic references, preserving deployed checkpoint semantics. [Numerical accuracy](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/main/notes/numerical_accuracy.html).

The 2025 model-level metamorphic-testing paper supports testing equivalent executions to expose framework inconsistencies. Applied here, trace identical inputs through embeddings, recurrent outputs, selected features, projections and candidate scores in both ModelView and the emitted predictor. Feature discrepancies with reported zero score discrepancies remain inconclusive: possible explanations include projection effects, rounding, cached scores or an unused feature path. Compare raw score tensors and deliberately perturb features to verify scoring dependence before interpreting history interventions or relaxing tolerances. These are proposed audit checks, not measured findings. [Model-level metamorphic testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.04354).
